Income Streams
5 streams of income
under 1 roof.
Stream 01 of 05
Personal Sales
Get paid 4x the PRMR on the following Friday, and the rest is paid on your backend.
Stream 02 of 05
Recruiting Overrides
Onboard new reps and get paid for their success. Overrides are paid on backend.
Stream 03 of 05
Leadership Bonus
Get paid more on your personal sales by being a team leader. Get an assistant manager bonus by hitting 300 downline accounts, and a manager bonus by hitting 500 downline accounts.
Stream 04 of 05
Residual Pay
Get paid every month for every funded account in your downline by becoming a Management Group Leader.
Stream 05 of 05
Company Equity
Get NRG stock by hitting 1,000 downline accounts.

Details
What counts toward FP+
1New family, funded
PRMR ÷ 85Upgrade, funded (added PRMR)
0.5DTH lead closed by NIS
Fine print
1The Pay Level is based on the total FP+ sold and funded in the sales season. FP+ is defined as funded families protected + (funded upgrades sold in the season PRMR/85) + (DTH leads closed by NIS × 0.5).
2The Base Commission Rate increases based on the rep’s funded FP+. The commissions are calculated by taking the funded PRMR × the base commission rate. Reps are paid $4 per dollar of funded PRMR upfront, and the remainder is reconciled on the backend.
3If the Rep funds at or above the 60 FP+ pay level the Rep will receive a rent bonus up to the lesser of the amount deducted for rent or $3,750. If the Rep funds at or above the 200 FP+ pay level the Rep will receive a rent bonus equal to the lesser of the amount deducted or $5,500. To receive the rent bonus on the October backend the Rep must fund at or above the 100 FP+ pay level.
4To earn the Assistant Manager Bonus, the Rep must fund 300 downline accounts.
5To earn the Manager Bonus, the Rep must fund 500 downline accounts.
*These pay scales are part of the Compensation Plan referenced in the 2026 Sales Representative Employment Agreements.

Details
How the MGMT override works
FP+ group × multiplier × PRMR per deal = override. The multiplier grows with your group’s size and its year-over-year FP+ growth.
$0.41Rookie bonus per funded rookie PRMR
$0.009Manager residual per PRMR, paid monthly
100 / 1,000Personal / downline accounts to qualify for residual
500 FP+Minimum pay level for a MGMT group
Fine print
1The MGMT group override is paid to the management group leader. A MGMT Group can only have one leader. MGMT and Team structure cannot be changed after May 15th, 2026. If the MGMT group funds less than 500 FP+ the MGMT Group will be paid at the 500 FP+ pay level.
2The Manager Override Pay Level is based on the funded FP+ sold and funded in the sales season.
3The base Manager Override is calculated by taking the total funded PRMR (rounded to 2 decimals) multiplied by the earned rate. The rates increase based on the total FP+ in volume and the YOY FP+ growth of the MGMT Group. Growth is based on the highest entity in the MGMT group leader’s name: if the leader has a MGMT group and a Sr. MGMT group, growth is based on the YOY FP+ growth of the Sr. MGMT Group.
4The Manager override has a bonus of $0.41 per funded rookie PRMR in the MGMT group. A rep with a prior season of at least 10 FP (excluding 2024 & 2025 extension) is not considered a rookie.
5The average rates shown are with 30% YOY FP+ growth and 40% of the FP+ from rookies.
6The Manager Residual is $0.009 per PRMR, calculated monthly by account (PRMR × $0.009). Residual is only assigned to a leader with 100 personal or 1,000 downline accounts. See the Residual Bonus plan agreement.
*These pay scales are part of the Compensation Plan referenced in the 2026 Sales Representative Employment Agreements.
Details
How the Area Director override works
FP+ office × multiplier × PRMR per deal = override. The multiplier grows with the total FP+ in your office, plus a bonus on every rookie account.
$0.24Rookie bonus per funded rookie PRMR
$0.007Area Director residual per PRMR, paid monthly
100 / 1,000Personal / downline accounts to qualify for residual
May 1Office leader must be declared by May 1st, 2026
Fine print
1The Area Director override is paid to the leader managing the sales office. Each sales office is owned by one leader, and the leader must be declared before May 1st, 2026.
2The Pay Level is based on the total funded FP+ sold and funded in the sales season.
3The Area Director Override is calculated by taking the total funded PRMR multiplied by the earned rate. The rates increase based on the total FP+ in the office.
4All rookie accounts in the office have a bonus of $0.24 per funded PRMR. A rep with a prior season of at least 10 FP (excluding extension 2024 & 2025) is not considered a rookie.
5The average rates shown are with 40% of the FP+ from rookies. Payable PRMR includes the PRMR adders and reductions on the Commission Adders and Commission Deductions pages.
6The Area Director Residual is $0.007 per PRMR, calculated monthly by account (PRMR × $0.007). Residual is only assigned to a leader with 100 personal or 1,000 downline accounts. See the Residual Bonus plan agreement.
*These pay scales are part of the Compensation Plan referenced in the 2026 Sales Representative Employment Agreements.
